data.name: Group.pricing
data.value: Pricing

data.name: Setting.billing.vat_rate.Label
data.value: VAT rate

data.name: Setting.billing.vat_rate.Help
data.value: Decimal rate: 0.19 for 19%. To be confirmed by the chartered accountant.

data.name: Setting.billing.daily_contribution_excl_vat.Label
data.value: Daily contribution excluding VAT

data.name: Setting.billing.daily_contribution_excl_vat.Help
data.value: Amount per day and per rented vehicle (2026 finance law), part of the VAT base.

data.name: Setting.billing.stamp_duty.Label
data.value: Stamp duty

data.name: Setting.billing.stamp_duty.Help
data.value: Amount added to each invoice. Value to be provided by the chartered accountant (0.000 meanwhile).

data.name: Setting.bookings.hold_duration.Label
data.value: Hold time of a web request

data.name: Setting.bookings.hold_duration.Help
data.value: How long a web request keeps a vehicle of its category before it expires if no agent validates it (24 h by default).

data.name: Setting.customers.document_image_retention_enabled.Label
data.value: Purge of identity document images

data.name: Setting.customers.document_image_retention_enabled.Help
data.value: Keep it off until the legal destruction procedure is validated (official report, law 2004-63).

data.name: Setting.customers.document_image_retention_days.Label
data.value: Retention of document images (days)

data.name: Setting.customers.document_image_retention_days.Help
data.value: Days kept after the person's last closed rental, or after the upload (400 by default).

data.name: Setting.drivers.minimum_age.Label
data.value: Minimum driver age

data.name: Setting.drivers.minimum_age.Help
data.value: Age on the pick-up date, in years (21 by default).

data.name: Setting.drivers.minimum_license_years.Label
data.value: Minimum licence seniority

data.name: Setting.drivers.minimum_license_years.Help
data.value: Years since the licence was issued, on the pick-up date (2 by default).

data.name: Setting.fleet.preparation_buffer.Label
data.value: Preparation buffer

data.name: Setting.fleet.preparation_buffer.Help
data.value: Time added after each return before the vehicle can leave again (2 h by default). Availability takes it into account at once.

data.name: Setting.outbox.processed_retention.Label
data.value: Retention of processed messages

data.name: Setting.outbox.processed_retention.Help
data.value: Processed background messages are deleted every night beyond this duration (30 days by default); failed messages are kept.

data.name: Setting.pricing.late_return_tolerance.Label
data.value: Late return tolerance

data.name: Setting.pricing.late_return_tolerance.Help
data.value: Delay allowed before one more rental day is counted (59 min by default).

data.name: Setting.drivers.young_driver_age_below.Label
data.value: Young driver surcharge age

data.name: Setting.drivers.young_driver_age_below.Help
data.value: A driver younger than this age on the pick-up date pays the young driver surcharge (YOUNG_DRIVER extra of the rate plan), in years (25 by default).

data.name: Setting.fleet.maintenance_due_soon_days.Label
data.value: Maintenance notice (days)

data.name: Setting.fleet.maintenance_due_soon_days.Help
data.value: A planned maintenance is flagged as due soon this many days before its date-based due date (30 by default).

data.name: Setting.fleet.maintenance_due_soon_km.Label
data.value: Maintenance notice (kilometres)

data.name: Setting.fleet.maintenance_due_soon_km.Help
data.value: A planned maintenance is flagged as due soon when the vehicle is within this distance of its mileage-based due point (1,000 km by default).

data.name: Setting.pricing.opening_hours.Label
data.value: Agency opening hours

data.name: Setting.pricing.opening_hours.Help
data.value: A pick-up or a return outside this range triggers the after-hours extra (AFTER_HOURS); both bounds count as open.

data.name: Setting.pricing.round_public_prices_to_dinar.Label
data.value: Round daily prices to the dinar

data.name: Setting.pricing.round_public_prices_to_dinar.Help
data.value: After the channel rule (markup), every published daily price is rounded to the nearest dinar; totals are still computed to the millime.

data.name: Group.public_site
data.value: Public site

data.name: Group.reporting
data.value: Reporting

data.name: Setting.public_site.eur_exchange_rate.Label
data.value: Indicative euro rate (TND for €1)

data.name: Setting.public_site.eur_exchange_rate.Help
data.value: Only used to show an indicative euro equivalent of dinar prices on the public site (price ÷ rate, rounded to the euro). Invoiced and paid amounts stay in TND.

data.name: Setting.reporting.funnel_event_retention_days.Label
data.value: Booking journey statistics retention (days)

data.name: Setting.reporting.funnel_event_retention_days.Help
data.value: How long the anonymous booking journey events (search, results, funnel steps) are kept; older ones are deleted every night. Shown on the privacy page.

data.name: Setting.bookings.information_request_extension.Label
data.value: Hold extension after an information request

data.name: Setting.bookings.information_request_extension.Help
data.value: Time added to the hold of a web request when the agent asks the customer for more information.

data.name: Setting.bookings.option_default_duration.Label
data.value: Default option duration

data.name: Setting.bookings.option_default_duration.Help
data.value: Expiry proposed for a phone option, never after the pick-up time.

data.name: Setting.bookings.payment_link_validity.Label
data.value: Payment time after validation (fallback mode)

data.name: Setting.bookings.payment_link_validity.Help
data.value: In the "payment link after validation" mode, time given to the customer to pay before the booking expires.

data.name: Setting.bookings.no_show_delay.Label
data.value: No-show delay

data.name: Setting.bookings.no_show_delay.Help
data.value: Delay after the planned pick-up time after which the agent may record a no-show.

data.name: Setting.bookings.escalation_delay.Label
data.value: Request escalation delay

data.name: Setting.bookings.escalation_delay.Help
data.value: A web request still unanswered after this delay is escalated to the manager, by e-mail and in the request queue.

data.name: Setting.bookings.cancellation_free_until_days.Label
data.value: Free cancellation until D-x

data.name: Setting.bookings.cancellation_free_until_days.Help
data.value: Calendar days before the pick-up until which a firm booking is cancelled free of charge.

data.name: Setting.bookings.cancellation_fee_percent.Label
data.value: Late cancellation fee

data.name: Setting.bookings.cancellation_fee_percent.Help
data.value: Share of the total incl. VAT charged after the deadline, between 0 and 1 (0.20 = 20 %).

data.name: Setting.bookings.validation_payment_mode.Label
data.value: Payment at validation

data.name: Setting.bookings.validation_payment_mode.Help
data.value: "Capture at validation": the validated request is confirmed (Clic to Pay capture, phase 2). "Payment link after validation" (fallback): it waits for its payment through a link.

data.name: Group.payments
data.value: Payments

data.name: Setting.payments.online_refund_approval_threshold.Label
data.value: Online refund approval threshold

data.name: Setting.payments.online_refund_approval_threshold.Help
data.value: Above this total (refunds of the payment already made or in progress included), an online refund waits for a manager's approval.

data.name: Setting.payments.payment_link_validity.Label
data.value: Payment link validity

data.name: Setting.payments.payment_link_validity.Help
data.value: How long a Clic to Pay payment link (fallback mode, phone, balance) can be paid; after that, the unpaid order is closed as expired.

data.name: Setting.payments.online_attempt_validity.Label
data.value: Online payment attempt validity

data.name: Setting.payments.online_attempt_validity.Help
data.value: How long a payment started on the website (booking, balance) can be completed before it is closed as expired.

data.name: Setting.reporting.snapshot_refresh_days.Label
data.value: Days computed again every night (snapshots)

data.name: Setting.reporting.snapshot_refresh_days.Help
data.value: Every night at 3 a.m., the daily snapshot of the fleet is computed again for the previous day and the days before it (7 days in all by default), so that a return, a no-show or a cost recorded late reaches it. Older days only change when the reports screen recomputes them.

data.name: Setting.reporting.sell_hint_months.Label
data.value: Window of the "sell or replace" hint (months)

data.name: Setting.reporting.sell_hint_months.Help
data.value: A vehicle whose margin (revenue minus commissions, direct costs and depreciation) is negative over these last months is flagged in the profitability table (6 months by default).

data.name: Group.messaging
data.value: WhatsApp

data.name: Setting.messaging.retention_days.Label
data.value: Conversation retention (days)

data.name: Setting.messaging.retention_days.Help
data.value: Older WhatsApp messages, then conversations without activity since, are deleted every night (365 days by default).

data.name: Setting.messaging.template_language.Label
data.value: Language of the WhatsApp templates

data.name: Setting.messaging.template_language.Help
data.value: Language code of the templates approved by Meta (fr, en, en_US…); it also sets the format of the dates and amounts sent.

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.booking_confirmed.Label
data.value: Template: booking confirmed

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.booking_confirmed.Help
data.value: Name of the approved template sent when a booking is confirmed; parameters: first name, booking number, pick-up date and time, pick-up place. Empty: not sent.

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.payment_link.Label
data.value: Template: payment due

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.payment_link.Help
data.value: Name of the approved template sent when a validated request waits for its payment; parameters: first name, booking number, amount due, deadline. Empty: not sent.

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.pickup_reminder.Label
data.value: Template: reminder the day before pick-up

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.pickup_reminder.Help
data.value: Name of the approved template; parameters: first name, booking number, pick-up date and time, place, address. Empty: not sent.

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.return_reminder.Label
data.value: Template: reminder the day before return

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.return_reminder.Help
data.value: Name of the approved template; parameters: first name, booking number, return date and time, place, address. Empty: not sent.

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.review_request.Label
data.value: Template: review request

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.review_request.Help
data.value: Name of the approved template sent the day after the return; parameters: first name, review link. Empty: not sent.

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.follow_up.Label
data.value: Template: conversation follow-up

data.name: Setting.messaging.templates.follow_up.Help
data.value: Name of the approved template an agent sends to get back in touch after the 24-hour window; parameter: customer name.

data.name: Setting.messaging.review_link.Label
data.value: Review request link

data.name: Setting.messaging.review_link.Help
data.value: Address of the agency's review page (Google), sent with the review request. Empty: no review request.

data.name: Group.ai
data.value: WhatsApp assistant (AI)

data.name: Setting.ai.enabled.Label
data.value: WhatsApp assistant on

data.name: Setting.ai.enabled.Help
data.value: The bot answers the customers on WhatsApp when an AI model is configured (Ai:Mode). Off: messages wait for an agent in the shared inbox.

data.name: Setting.ai.max_bot_turns.Label
data.value: Bot turns per conversation

data.name: Setting.ai.max_bot_turns.Help
data.value: Beyond this number of bot replies in a conversation, it goes to an agent with a polite message (30 by default).

data.name: Setting.ai.max_tokens.Label
data.value: Tokens per conversation

data.name: Setting.ai.max_tokens.Help
data.value: Tokens used (input, output and cache) beyond which the conversation goes to an agent (300,000 by default).

data.name: Setting.ai.max_cost_usd.Label
data.value: Highest cost of a conversation (USD)

data.name: Setting.ai.max_cost_usd.Help
data.value: AI cost and estimated Meta cost of a conversation beyond which it goes to an agent (USD 0.50 by default).

data.name: Setting.ai.max_model_calls_per_turn.Label
data.value: Model calls per turn

data.name: Setting.ai.max_model_calls_per_turn.Help
data.value: Model calls to answer a single customer message; beyond, the conversation goes to an agent (4 by default).

data.name: Setting.ai.max_tool_calls_per_turn.Label
data.value: Tool calls per turn

data.name: Setting.ai.max_tool_calls_per_turn.Help
data.value: Tool calls (search, quote, information, status, transfer) for a single customer message; beyond, the conversation goes to an agent (6 by default).

data.name: Setting.ai.max_status_lookups.Label
data.value: Booking lookups per conversation

data.name: Setting.ai.max_status_lookups.Help
data.value: Booking status lookups allowed in a conversation (3 by default), against guessing numbers.

data.name: Setting.ai.max_turns_without_progress.Label
data.value: Turns without progress before transfer

data.name: Setting.ai.max_turns_without_progress.Help
data.value: Consecutive turns without a useful result (no option, no link, no information, need unchanged) beyond which the conversation goes to an agent (6 by default).

data.name: Setting.ai.price_input_usd_per_mtok.Label
data.value: Input token price (USD per million)

data.name: Setting.ai.price_input_usd_per_mtok.Help
data.value: Price of a million input tokens of the model (USD 0.10 for Claude Haiku 5.5 up to 100,000 prompt tokens); check it on the pricing page.

data.name: Setting.ai.price_output_usd_per_mtok.Label
data.value: Output token price (USD per million)

data.name: Setting.ai.price_output_usd_per_mtok.Help
data.value: Price of a million output tokens, thinking included (USD 0.50 for Claude Haiku 5.5); check it on the pricing page.

data.name: Setting.ai.price_cache_read_ratio.Label
data.value: Cache read (share of the input price)

data.name: Setting.ai.price_cache_read_ratio.Help
data.value: Price of a token read from the prompt cache, as a share of the input price (0.1); check it on the pricing page.

data.name: Setting.ai.price_cache_write_ratio.Label
data.value: Cache write (share of the input price)

data.name: Setting.ai.price_cache_write_ratio.Help
data.value: Price of a token written to the prompt cache, as a share of the input price (1.25 for a 5-minute cache, 2 for one hour); check it on the pricing page.

data.name: Setting.ai.meta_usd_per_message.Label
data.value: Estimated Meta cost of a reply (USD)

data.name: Setting.ai.meta_usd_per_message.Help
data.value: Estimated cost of a billable bot reply (service message beyond the 1,000 free ones per month). Enter the agency's Meta rate for Tunisia ("Rest of Africa" zone); 0 by default.
